}}'''Parelean''' was a member of [[Cha Faile]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Parelean}} He was from [[Tear]].

== Appearance ==
He had a square chin. He had a beard but started shaving once he joined ''Cha Faile''.

== Activities ==
He follows [[Faile Bashere]] to [[Ghealdan]] and seems to be one of the leaders of ''Cha Faile''.
<nowiki> </nowiki>Faile thinks that he and Selande are the smartest among them, though [[Camaille Nolaisen|Camaille]] and [[Arrela Shiego|Arrela]] are quicker thinkers. He manages to tell Faile about [[Masema Dagar]] meeting with the [[Seanchan]] before he is killed in battle with the [[Shaido]].
